items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: another guy who used to come down, a white guy, selling pot, Dr. Fu.

ctx.x: So he would furnish us with -- we'd buy pot from him, right at the joint. So we just stayed high. But nobody thought anything about it, it wasn't hard stuff. As a matter of fact once I got Art to smoke some pot, and he was a confirmed drinker, you know. He loved at that time [Kingsberry] Beer. It's -- I think that was a western beer. And yeah, we had Dr. -- another guy who used to come down, a white guy, selling pot, Dr. Fu. Oh, it was real good, you
know, so we would buy pot from him and then we would hang out the rest of the morning, you know.
